data.narrative:
Space Forge is a Series G-stage space and aerospace company founded by Joshua Western and Andrew Bacon, having raised $22.6M to date. The valuation universe includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning the sector, though narrow-band peer matching at the same stage proved insufficient (fewer than 3 datapoints after filtering).

Of three triangulation methods examined, only stage-progression analysis was applicable. Using $9M as a proxy for base value derived from total capital raised, a 1.25x step-up multiplier typical for Series G progression yields an implied valuation of $11M. Peer-median analysis could not proceed due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within Space & Aerospace (0 and 1 respectively). Public-comp anchoring was inapplicable because Space Forge's revenue is not disclosed; the sector median P/S of 24.4x across 5 public tickers cannot be applied without this input.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $10M to $13M, with a median point of $11M. This reflects a single methodological lens and carries material uncertainty. Key gaps include the absence of same-stage private comparables, undisclosed revenue preventing multiple-based anchoring, and limited market data for frontier space technologies. Validation would require either revenue disclosure or identification of additional Series G peer transactions.
